English: Coin Chamber
A hastily dug earthen pit sheltered under wooden planks, serving as a rudimentary chamber for storing newly gathered coinage and valuables.
Strongbox Room
A locked wooden crate within a guarded tent, this strongbox room provides a primitive but more secure space for treasury storage.
Archive Cellar
A sunken stone cellar beneath the keep, doubling as a record room for ledgers and a vault for coins, guarded day and night.
Treasury Vault
A fortified underground vault with stone walls and iron doors, protected by armed guards and intricate locks, for the storage of the realms wealth.
Gold Reserve
A deep, heavily fortified chamber lined with granite, where gold bars and coinage are meticulously counted and guarded by elite soldiers and traps.
Waqf Treasury
A grand structure managing the endowments and revenues of the realm, with secure vaults and elite guards ensuring stability and prosperity.
Minting Room
A dedicated chamber with skilled coiners and stamping tools, ensuring the steady production of standardized coinage for the realm.
Diwan Safehouse
An inner sanctum managed by the Diwan, where the realms greatest treasures and sensitive records are protected by elite retainers and secret passages.
Royal Treasury
The most secure and lavish treasury of the realm, combining advanced security, administration, and displays of wealth to awe vassals and deter thieves.
House of Wealth
A monumental treasury complex at the heart of the castle, protected by masterful defenses, housing the riches and ledgers of a powerful realm, and serving as a symbol of prosperity and order.
